items.title: Rhysida hits Berlin Senate network
items.summary: Berlin's Senate administration network was hit by a ransomware attack attributed to the Rhysida group this month.

items.title: The Gentlemen ransomware strikes Canadian airline
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group claimed an attack on a Canadian airline in early September.

items.title: Metaencryptor claims South Korean camera-module maker
items.summary: Metaencryptor listed a South Korean camera module and equipment manufacturer as a victim in late September.

items.title: Metaencryptor claims Japanese automotive parts manufacturer
items.summary: The same group also claimed a Japanese automotive parts supplier, a supply-chain exposure for downstream OEMs.

items.title: Ransomware victim volume remains elevated
items.summary: Black Kite's 2026 report counts 7,551 ransomware victims, up 24.9% year over year.

ransomware.note: Victim names are withheld by several leak-site trackers this week; sector and country shown where the company is unnamed.

items.title: Azure East US failure takes down major AI services
items.summary: A Sept 3 Azure East US region failure degraded ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Microsoft Copilot within about 90 minutes, with 66,000+ combined Downdetector reports.

items.title: AWS confirms permanent data loss in Bahrain region
items.summary: AWS confirmed unrecoverable data loss in its Bahrain region after damage from a March conflict spanned multiple Availability Zones, exceeding multi-AZ design limits.

items.title: Forrester: multi-day hyperscaler outages expected in 2026
items.summary: Forrester predicts at least two major multi-day hyperscaler outages this year as providers prioritize AI infrastructure over legacy systems.

outage.note: No new hyperscaler-wide outage surfaced in the past week; the Sept 3 Azure event remains the month's headline.

items.title: ShinyHunters claims breach of U.S. federal law enforcement agency
items.summary: ShinyHunters claimed it breached a U.S. federal law enforcement agency and stole sensitive data; the claim is unverified.

items.title: CISA adds seven exploited flaws to KEV
items.summary: Additions cover Sangoma Switchvox, Kludex Starlette, Kestra OSS, BerriAI LiteLLM, JFrog Artifactory and SonicWall SMA1000, with attackers deploying reverse shells and crypto miners.

items.title: Chromium V8 type confusion added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-85046, a Google Chromium V8 type confusion bug, based on evidence of active exploitation.

items.title: Adobe zero-day exploited for three days before hotfix
items.summary: CVE-2026-75650 was exploited from Sept 4 until Adobe's Sept 7 hotfix and was part of CISA's Sept 8 KEV additions.

items.title: Ten CVEs newly confirmed exploited in the past week
items.summary: Newly exploited flaws span nine vendors including Microsoft, MikroTik, WordPress and WSO2.

items.title: Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii
items.summary: Hurricane Nolo is bringing flash-flood risk and extreme surf to the Hawaiian Islands, with the Big Island bracing for potentially catastrophic flooding.

items.title: Typhoon Dujuan strikes Japan
items.summary: Typhoon Dujuan left four dead and several missing in Japan in early September.

items.title: Deadly floods in Nepal, Tibet and the Philippines
items.summary: Deadly flooding hit Nepal and Tibet as well as the Philippines, alongside heavy rain and flooding in Mecca.

items.title: Deadly forest fires in Algeria
items.summary: Forest fires in Algeria caused fatalities in early September.

items.title: M 6.6 earthquake near New Caledonia
items.summary: An M 6.6 quake struck 80 km ENE of Tadine, New Caledonia on Sept 25; no tsunami, USGS green alert.

physical.note: Pacific tropical activity (Nolo, Dujuan) is the main BC exposure this week.
